description: Run one operator-approved OpenAI image generation through ReqLLM, persist its request and usage receipt, stage the exact bytes, publish the approved draft through the existing idempotent path, verify the live DelveTown record, and prove retries create no second generation request or post.

comments.text: Preflight passed on 2026-10-06. Runtime settings version 6 keep autonomy observe, manual publication off, and image generation off. The configured manual provider is OpenAI model gpt-image-1-mini at 1024x1024 medium quality with a daily limit of 1. No image generation request exists, so the durable usage count is 0 of 1. The local environment file contains an OpenAI API key. Awaiting operator confirmation for one paid external image generation request. Live publication will need a separate confirmation after the generated image is reviewed.

The first confirmed generation attempt did not reach an image provider. Request qa:reqllm:2026-10-06:agentjido-network-garden is durable as uncertain with attempt_count 1, no usage, no response metadata, no artifact, and no draft. The failure occurred immediately because the temporary runtime build had a broken llm_db priv link; an offline prepare_request in that build reproduced LLMDB.LoadError :enoent before request construction. I disabled image generation in settings version 8, compiled the normal project build, proved the same offline ReqLLM request preparation succeeds there, stopped the temporary runtime, and started the dashboard from the normal build. The uncertain receipt remains unchanged for audit and idempotency proof. A replacement provider request needs a new operator confirmation and a temporary daily limit increase from 1 to 2.

title: Verify one ReqLLM image from generation through live publication
